outcome_detail.diagnosis_hint: Each iteration took 5+ minutes just running cargo build (340s → 310s). Progress was marginal (30s improvement). The check itself (build_under_120s) is a perf target that requires deep architectural changes (incremental compilation, feature gating, dependency pruning) — not achievable in a closed loop. ISSUE: perf-optimization goals are poor candidates for goal supervisor (feedback loop too slow — 5min/iter). max_total_duration_min default (30min) correctly stopped it. Skill should flag perf goals and recommend manual approach or much longer budget.
